name: Nicolae Ștefănuță - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the mobilisation of the European Globalisation Adjustment Fund for Displaced Workers following an application from Belgium – EGF/2025/006 BE/Audi
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees to release money from a European Union fund that helps workers who lose their jobs. Belgium asked for help after carmaker Audi closed its Brussels plant and 3,414 workers lost their jobs, along with jobs at five suppliers. The fund will pay 7.5 million euro, which is 85 percent of the cost of counselling, training, job-search help, and support for starting a business. The Parliament also calls for the old factory site to be reused for new jobs.

- **What changes:** 7.5 million euro is released to help 3,414 former Audi and supplier workers in Belgium find new jobs.
- **Who it affects:** Laid-off workers in Brussels, East Flanders and Hainaut, many with low education or over 54.
- **What happens next:** Belgium runs the support measures, and the Parliament asks for a final check on results.
